@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Dream Law
@category:  Training Package
#
# Format: <level> | <spell_name> | <area_effect> | <duration> | <range> | <type>
# A trailing '*' on the name marks a Concentration / continuing-effect spell.
#
 1 | Sleep | 1 target | - | 50’ | Fm
 2 | Store Dream Pattern | 1 target | P | varies | Pm
 3 | Store Dreamer Pattern | 1 target | P | 50’ | Pm
 4 | Observe Waking Dream | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | 50’ | Pm
 5 | Observe Sleeping Dream | 1 target | 1 min/lvl (C) | varies | Pm
 6 | Induce Daydream | 1 target | varies | 50’ | Fm
 7 | Locate Dreamer I | caster | - | 100’/lvl | Pm
 8 | Induce Dream | 1 target | varies | varies | Fm
 9 | Dream Guard | 1 target | sleep | 50’ | U
10 | Induce Nightmare | 1 target | varies | varies | Fm
11 | Weave Daydream | caster | C | self | U
12 | Undream | 1 target | - | 50’ | Fm
13 | Weave Dream | caster | C | self | U
14 | Locate Dreamer II | caster | - | 1,000’/lvl | Pm
15 | Weave Nightmare | caster | C | self | U
17 | Insomnia | 1 target | 1 day/10 fail | 50’ | Fm
18 | Mass Daydream | 1 target/lvl | 1 rnd/lvl | 50’ | Fm
20 | Locate Dreamer III | caster | - | 1 mi/lvl | Pm
25 | Mass Dream | 1 target/lvl | varies | varies | Fm
30 | Mass Nightmare | 1 target/lvl | varies | varies | Fm
50 | Locate Dreamer True | caster | - | unlimited | Pm

# Descriptions
@@ 1
The target falls into natural sleep. The first round is a magical sleep (the
target cannot be awakened through normal means).
@@ 2
The caster may store the dream pattern of a daydream or sleeping dream of a
given target for future use. The caster may only have as many daydream
patterns and as many sleeping dream patterns stored as his Memory stat (not
the stat bonus) and may release a stored pattern at any given time. The
caster’s player is responsible for recording which patterns are stored. Note
that the caster cannot be the target of this spell.
@@ 3
The caster may store the dreamself pattern of a given target (for use with
spells on this list and on the Dream Lore list). The caster must also be
asleep at time of casting. The caster may only have as many dream-self
patterns stored as his Memory stat (not stat bonus) and may release a stored
pattern at any given time. The caster’s player is responsible for recording
which patterns are stored.
@@ 4
The caster can passively share (by concentrating upon this spell) any
daydreams experienced by the target during the spell’s duration. He will
receive not only the events of the daydream but the reactions and surface
thoughts which arise as a result of the daydream.
@@ 5
The caster can passively share (by concentrating upon this spell) any sleeping
dreams experienced by the target during the spell’s duration.
@@ 6
The caster may induce a daydream in the target’s mind, distracting the target
for as long as the target entertains the daydream (or perhaps as long as the
daydream entertains the target!). The caster may elect to either induce a
random daydream (allowing the target’s mind to supply the topic and the
details), a daydream on a specific topic (the target’s mind supplies the
details), or a daydream pattern previously stored by the caster.
@@ 7
The caster can locate the chosen target in terms of both direction and
distance. The caster must have previously stored the target’s dream-self
pattern, the target must be asleep, and the target must be within 100’ per
level of the caster at time of casting.
@@ 8
The caster may induce a dream (not of nightmarish aspect) in a sleeping
target. The caster may elect to either induce a dream on a specific topic (the
target’s mind supplies the details) or to use a dream pattern previously
stored by the caster.
@@ 9
This spell causes a portion of the target’s subconscious mind to monitor any
attempts by others to detect, store, observe, or manipulate the target’s
dream-self pattern (or his dreams) for the duration of his sleep cycle. Such
spells must make an RR versus the level of the caster (if the RR is successful
the detection, etc., may proceed normally). If the RR fails, the target’s
subconscious is alerted to the nature of the incoming spell and it relays this
information to the caster’s conscious mind (and the incoming spell fails). The
caster of this spell must be awake and within 50’ of the target to receive any
warnings.
@@ 10
As Induce Dream, except the caster may induce a nightmare (with ramifications
at the GM’s discretion).
@@ 11
By concentrating with this spell, the caster can create a daydream on any
topic he desires with the level of detail limited by the caster’s imagination,
and the duration of the spell limited only by the caster’s ability to
concentrate. Once the caster has completed his weaving, he must concentrate
for a further round to store the parameters for future use (this counts as a
dream stored with the Store Dream Pattern spell). If the caster’s
concentration is interrupted or ends before the creation is complete, the
daydream will also be incomplete. Note the caster can decide to leave certain
aspects of the dream to be created spontaneously by the minds of targets in
which the daydream is later induced.
@@ 12
The target of this spell will be unable to dream during his next sleep cycle
if he fails to resist this spell.
@@ 13
As Weave Daydream, except the caster weaves a normal dream (not a nightmare).
@@ 14
As Locate Dreamer I, except the range is 1,000’ per level of the caster.
@@ 15
As Weave Dream, except the caster weaves a nightmare.
@@ 17
The target of this spell will be unable to sleep, and will therefore forfeit
any benefits that the lost sleep would have provided (healing, PP recovery,
etc.).
@@ 18
As Daydream, except affects one target per level of the caster chosen at time
of casting and the caster may only induce a specific daydream pattern which
will be shared by all the targets.
@@ 20
As Locate Dreamer I, except the range is 1 mile per level of the caster.
@@ 25
As Dream, except affects one target per level of the caster chosen at time of
casting and the caster may only induce a specific dream pattern which will be
shared by all the targets.
@@ 30
As Nightmare, except affects one target per level of the caster chosen at time
of casting and the caster may only induce a specific dream pattern which will
be shared by all the targets.
@@ 50
As Locate Dreamer I, except the range is unlimited.
